category_profile_relationships.method: Pearson correlation across fifteen measured discovery category-mean activations
confound_limits: Descriptive association on the discovery corpus; no significance or independent replication claim.
Category means can reflect shared lexical items, prompt lengths, and authored category choices.
Candidate selection used these discovery activations, which biases selected-profile comparisons.
No neuron interaction, connection, shared semantic function, or causal relationship is established.
No cross-layer down-projection vector comparison is performed; hidden coordinate bases are not assumed aligned.

registered_checks.correlation: Evaluate fixed target-vs-rest prompt-mean AUC on validation and untouched test; exploratory threshold AUC>=0.8 in both. Report n=3 positive per category, p values with Holm adjustment across four candidates.
registered_checks.counterexamples: Positive/paraphrase/OOD versus negative/near-miss activation. Paraphrases share source_id with validation positive originals, never cross splits.
registered_checks.distribution_selectivity: At +1 SD only, compare (candidate KL - mean projected-direction-control KL) on target vs other prompts; stratified prompt bootstrap95%CI. Require positive lower bound on validation AND test to support only a category-selective distribution effect.
registered_checks.semantic_function: Not established by KL, AUC, or technical restoration. Require independent behavioral task correctness and confound-matched study before a semantic causal label.
registered_checks.multiple_selection: 737280 discovery coordinates screened; discovery ranking is descriptive, not statistical significance. Four fixed heldout hypotheses are reported, not a rescreened test leaderboard.

interpretation.catalog_label_policy: All four entries remain ambiguous pending independent review
interpretation.bootstrap_unit: independent corpus prompt; counterexamples use source_id family means
interpretation.p_value_scope: Two-sided label permutations, 2000 resamples, plus-one correction; Holm across four fixed hypotheses per held-out split
interpretation.selection_caveat: Discovery screened 737280 coordinates; no discovery significance claim. Four hypotheses were frozen before held-out measurements.
interpretation.causal_signature_scope: Category-selective next-token distribution effect at the last chat-template token only; no semantic behavior claim
